tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: File upload and media management endpoints

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all products belonging to the authenticated organization.

post.description: Creates a new product for the authenticated organization.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all soft-deleted products belonging to the authenticated organization.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted product by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific product by its ID.

patch.description: Updates the details of an existing product.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a product by its ID.

post.description: Attaches a media image to a product.

delete.description: Removes an image from a product.

patch.description: Sets the display order of product images.

get.description: Retrieves all variants belonging to a specific product.

post.description: Creates a new variant for a specific product.

get.description: Globally search and list variants across the entire organization. Useful for comboboxes and quick lookups.
Quickly find a variant by its exact SKU. Used for barcode scanning in POS.
Retrieves a paginated list of all soft-deleted variants.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted variant by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific variant by its ID.

patch.description: Updates the details of an existing variant.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a product variant by its ID.

post.description: Attaches a media image to a variant.

delete.description: Removes an image from a variant.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all warehouses belonging to the authenticated organization.

post.description: Creates a new warehouse for the authenticated organization.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific warehouse by its ID.

patch.description: Updates the details of an existing warehouse.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a warehouse by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of stock movements for the authenticated organization. Supports filtering by variant, warehouse, and movement type.

post.description: Records a new stock movement (IN, OUT, or ADJUSTMENT) and atomically updates the variant's stock cache.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific stock movement by its ID.

delete.description: Deletes a stock movement and reverses its effect on the variant stock cache atomically.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of suppliers for the authenticated organization. Supports filtering by active status and sorting.

post.description: Creates a new supplier for the authenticated organization.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific supplier by its ID.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a supplier by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of customers for the authenticated organization. Supports filtering by active status, searching by name/email, and sorting.

post.description: Creates a new customer for the authenticated organization.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of soft-deleted customers for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted customer by setting isActive to true.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific customer by its ID.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a customer by setting isActive to false.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of purchase orders for the authenticated organization. Supports filtering by status, payment status, supplier, and warehouse.

post.description: Creates a new purchase order with line items for the authenticated organization.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific purchase order by its ID, including all line items.

patch.description: Updates the status, payment status, or other fields of an existing purchase order. RECEIVED status cannot be set here — use the /receive endpoint. COMPLETED requires all items to be fully received.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a purchase order. Only allowed when status is PENDING.

post.description: Marks items as received on a purchase order. Only allowed when status is CONFIRMED or SHIPPED. Updates received quantities and creates stock-in movements.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of sales orders for the authenticated organization. Supports filtering by status, payment status, customer, and search by note, guest email, or guest name.

post.description: Creates a new sales order with line items for the authenticated organization. Either customerId or guestName must be provided.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific sales order by its ID, including all line items with variant details.

patch.description: Updates header fields of an existing sales order. Items cannot be modified after creation.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a sales order. Only allowed when status is PENDING or CANCELLED.

post.description: Creates a new API key for the authenticated organization with scoped permissions.

get.description: Retrieves all API keys belonging to the authenticated organization.
Retrieves the details of a specific API key by its ID.

patch.description: Updates the details of an existing API key (name, enabled, permissions, rate limit).

delete.description: Revokes and deletes an API key by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of members in the authenticated organization.
Retrieves the details of a specific member by their ID.

patch.description: Updates the role of an existing member in the organization.

delete.description: Removes a member from the authenticated organization.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of invitations for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Sends an invitation to join the authenticated organization with the specified role.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific invitation by its ID.

delete.description: Cancels a pending invitation to the organization.

post.description: Accepts a pending invitation and adds the user as a member of the organization.
Rejects a pending invitation to join the organization.

get.description: Retrieves all pending invitations sent to the current user.
Returns all available permission resources, actions, and permission strings for creating custom roles.
Returns all custom roles with their permissions for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Creates a new custom role with specified permissions. Requires owner/admin permission.

get.description: Retrieves a specific custom role by its ID.

patch.description: Updates an existing custom role's name and/or permissions. System roles cannot be modified.

delete.description: Deletes a custom role and all its permissions. System roles cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns the list of resources the current user can view and all specific permission strings (resource:action) for the active organization.
Returns weekly sales, monthly revenue, pending pickup count, and active customer count for the authenticated organization.
Returns the 5 most recent sales orders with customer name, first item name, status, and total price.
Returns revenue comparison and verdict for the given preset period (today, this-week, this-month) against the equivalent previous period.

get.summary: Get stock health report with verdict
get.description: Returns stock level analysis with verdict (healthy, running-low, critical) and the top 5 lowest-stock variants.
Returns paginated sales report grouped by SKU with quantity sold and revenue for the given preset period. Only COMPLETED and DELIVERED orders are included.

post.description: Returns a presigned PUT URL for direct upload to S3-compatible storage and creates a pending media record.
Confirms that a file upload to S3 has been completed. Returns the full media record with public URL.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of media for the authenticated organization. Optionally filter by purpose.
Retrieves a single media record by its ID with public URL.

delete.description: Deletes a media record and its file from S3-compatible storage.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audit logs for the authenticated organization. Supports filtering by model, operation, auth type, and user.
Retrieves a paginated list of all product categories belonging to the authenticated organization. Filter by parentId to load tree levels.

post.description: Creates a new product category for the authenticated organization.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all soft-deleted product categories belonging to the authenticated organization.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted product category by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all products belonging to the given category and its descendants (recursive).
Retrieves the details of a specific product category by its ID.

patch.description: Updates the details of an existing product category.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a product category by its ID. Children categories are orphaned (parentId set to null) and linked products have their categoryId cleared.

get.description: Fetches all records for the requested models for the current organization. Used for initial data load.
Fetches records updated since the given timestamp for the requested models. Includes soft-deleted records.

post.description: Processes a batch of offline mutations. Each mutation is processed in order. Returns per-mutation results with success/conflict/failed status.
Send a natural language message to the AI assistant for product management. Returns structured responses with confirmation requirements for write operations.
